notes.title: Update 0.52
notes.content:
Gameplay


 In the board builder removed the lock on units. All units are now available in builder without the need to complete the campaign as campaign will be replaced shortly.
 New animation system to handle pathfinding, missiles and animations. 
 100's of bugs fixed to many to mention. 
 Added a new puzzle section, more puzzles to come with every update. 



Units, Environments and Objects


 New environments like snow, fallout, poison, ion, healing and repair added.
 New wall system added to sandbox (light and concrete walls), which can be used as cover or to create puzzles. 


Visual


 Added health bars.
 Made the bars on the tiles that show combat stance and abilities a lot smaller.
 Removed the black and white tiles on multiplayer to make way for a new terrain update in the next update.
 Added dynamic lighting and better shadows, previous versions, shadows did not show.


UI


 Fixed UI bugs with buttons not showing highlighted.
 Completely reworked the sandbox building UI to add and edit units easier and included walls and environments.


Networking


 Updating networking code, data is now getting from server to client much faster.
 Add a method to handle curl network errors


Memory


 Fixed a memory leak issue when the game connected to server to get data.

notes.title: Update 0.23
notes.content:
New Cover System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652245/5467be72695f5b909c28f9d27cd4e8c07932a274.jpg

We introduced a new tiered cover system. What this means is foot soldier can take cover behind any suitable object. Cover will be either light or heavy cover and light cover won't protect foot soldier from artillery or missiles.

Action Point System Upgraded

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652245/9297a1cdfe024c20d5dbad31019660d1ef16472f.jpg

Legions at war can be used to play chess like games like into the breach where units typically only have one action point. The engine however can be also be used to play Xcom styled games where units have multiple action points per turn. We upgraded the AP system to make it easier to move units multiple AP per turn but still also play chess like games with 1 AP.

New Scale System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652245/c8c3078fbece4c37eff9e59022949ee297e7edc7.jpg

With the coming updates we will add allot more units that are scaled to take up multiple tiles. This allows for some interesting maneuvering capabilities and correctly scales the large arsenal of units 30+ to real world examples.

notes.title: Update 0.22
notes.content:
Some new features for update 0.22 :

[previewyoutube=cwAwa5L11o8;full][/previewyoutube]

Environments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32652245/877efa21e4f9477d65e60cde6346af5d6eb3837a.jpg

Environments can damage, heal, cripple or support units. You can simply paint any specific environment after or before units have been placed on the board. 

Some environments are also spawned after the attack of specific unit. The large nuclear weapon now leaves fallout clouds that damage health. The ION cannon, after attack create a suffocating cloud damaging turns.

Snow – Reduces movement of units
Suffocating Cloud – Reduces turns of units
Fallout – Reduces health of units
Poison – Reduces damage of units
Repair – Heals/repairs units
Ammunition – Addition special abilities for units.

UI

UI for the world editor have been revamped.

Some Legionaries found the world editor difficult to navigate so we added a quickplay section. You can quickly edit some variables and click generate to create a random board.

Game sets have also bee added to the UI. The first game set is chess with much more to be added soon. You will be able to create certain type of game quickly with game sets.

notes.title: Game AI
notes.content:
Game AI

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652245/a036aaa4683a7f0eece62bd6cc8f0fe6f6d1ce10.jpg

Creating the AI for legions at war isan interesting journey, as there are several ways the AI can analyse the trillions of possible layouts.

When to attack:

1.	Always attack first, no threat or ranking algorithms.
2.	Attack based on ranking and threat algorithms.
3.	Randomly attack.

When to move:

1.	Never move unto tiles that can be attacked.
2.	Move with backup.
3.	Randomly move.
4.	Move based on threat and victory algorithms.

When to use abilities or change combat stance:

1.	Based on threat and victory algorithms.
2.	Random

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652245/850545e37385dfbd56e4630bd322f433169aafb5.jpg

By offering the player a tweakable AI, it encourages the creation of extremely interesting and challenging layouts. The AI has been structured to allow the player to change different behavioural stats of the AI, when creating a game.
